text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. There are six days and one
minute left until the
contest.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Our goal is to start on a design and finalize
it within the day. Let's
keep up the good
work together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to interrupt, but I don't see Flower
anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry. She said she had to put on the
ribbons, so she's running a
bit late.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: What ribbons?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sorry I'm late!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Flash? Bourbon? Please have these...
if you like! Jordan helped
me make them.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You made cakes based on us, so I thought
that if you had something
based on
yourselves too, it might give you a new
perspective for
ideas!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And, well... The main reason is that I was
happy you made a cake for
me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
We only have a little longer to work on
this, but I'm having so much
fun! Thank
you for inviting me to join you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for helping us. Hehe, do I really
look that serious?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, good going, Flower! Oh! Why don't
you put them here together
with ours?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yo, this is fire! Can I post it on
Umastagram?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Excellent!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me. My status was "excited" for a
brief moment there.
Excellent work,
Flower. You gave me an idea.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you! Um...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A cake that represents our desire to win.
How about a cupcake tower
where each
cupcake is modeled on us?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
We could put the cupcakes on pedestals,
representing the students
winning and
Tracen Academy's spirit for victory.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see! Yes, that would certainly portray
both ideas, and we could
execute it within
the time limit.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A cupcake tower... Let's proceed with that!
Thank you, Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Heh, not at all! I-I'm... glad I helped. Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the final six-day stretch begins...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
How shall we make each cupcake
different? Let's take today to study
cake
designs in this cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Status—"thinking." Update—I have an idea.
Just like this tart, we
could make part of
our cake out of something other than
sponge.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see! Something like... zuckerteig, or
hefeteig. Namely, a biscuit base
or a
fermented dough. That's not a bad idea!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely not! An overly sparkly
decoration for the cups would be
far too
showy to represent the students of Tracen
Academy!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Come on, isn't it better to be a bit extra?
Yours is too basic!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It is not! It is a clean and refined design
befitting our students!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Then how about purple, like our
uniforms?

text_block_list.name: The Two
text_block_list.text:
That's the one!
That's it!

text_block_list.name: Presenter
text_block_list.text:
The fierce competition begins once again
at this year's Spring Choice
Chocolatier
Contest!

text_block_list.name: Presenter
text_block_list.text:
Seventeen teams are participating, but
who will win the grand prize
and go home
with the dazzling crown? Let the baking
begin!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: All right! Go get 'em, besties!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bake Bakushin-style out there! Flash!
Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Toi, toi, toi... Exhale... Bourbon, let's aim for nothing less than first place. I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. I will work at full capacity.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mixing bowl, whisk, cream,
temperature—all okay. Setup complete. I

will now combine the milk fat globules
with air.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You've improved a lot, Bourbon. Ah, I had
better start on the cake
batter.

text_block_list.name: Presenter
text_block_list.text:
Next up, Tracen Academy! They are
making steady progress, wouldn't
you say?

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's rare for this contest to have
entrants from a racing school. I
believe
they don't even have a confectionery
course.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Proceeding to the matcha cream, page
twenty-three of the recipe. At
present, the
color is slightly different from what's
written in the
recipe.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In that case, add one gram of matcha and
4.2 grams of granulated
sugar.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Flash, the oven will finish
preheating in forty-two
seconds.

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what a meticulous recipe. I get the
feeling we can expect
something special
from these two.
